title: Seat Group Power Distribution Unit — Installation
abstract: Installation of a seat group power distribution unit and its connection to the cabin feeder, with the load measurement that confirms the seat group draws inside the allowance for its position.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of one seat group power distribution unit, either in the footwell mounting or on the seat track cradle, and the load check that closes the installation.
sections.job_setup_note: Isolate the cabin seat power distribution at the panel and put the warning notice on it. Confirm which mounting the seat group uses, because the cradle installation needs the tubular spacers and the footwell installation does not. Have the clamp meter available; the load check is part of the task and cannot be deferred to the next check.
sections.procedure: Confirm that the seat power distribution is isolated and dead at the seat group connector. Remove the seat cushions and lift the seat pan to reach the mounting. For a footwell installation, clean the mounting face and check the captive nuts. For a cradle installation, fit the seat track cover D4420008271203 with its cradle, setting the standoff with tubular spacers EN187472K9 and securing it with anchor nuts EN258434K3 tightened to 4.5 Nm. CAUTION: DO NOT ROUTE THE SEAT HARNESS ACROSS THE CRADLE EDGE WITHOUT THE PROTECTIVE SLEEVING. THE EDGE WILL CUT THE HARNESS UNDER SEAT MOVEMENT. Fit protective sleeving AES430915-41 where the harness crosses the cradle edge. Install the distribution unit and torque its fasteners to the value in the illustration. Connect the feeder connector and the seat harness connectors. Lower the seat pan and confirm that the unit clears the seat actuation envelope through the full recline travel. WARNING: DO NOT OPERATE THE SEAT RECLINE WITH A HAND INSIDE THE SEAT PAN. THE MECHANISM CLOSES WITHOUT WARNING. Restore the distribution and measure the current drawn by the seat group with every outlet loaded, using the clamp meter. Confirm that the reading is inside the allowance for the position.
sections.close_out: Refit the seat cushions and remove the warning notice from the distribution panel. Record the measured seat group current against the seat row identity, because the cabin load analysis is built from those readings. Confirm that the seat display and the power outlet at every seat of the group work before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The cradle mounting applies only to seat groups converted to the seat track installation.

safety_precautions: Isolate the cabin seat power distribution and put the warning notice on the panel.
Do not operate the seat recline with a hand inside the seat pan.
